paragraphs: While Scrum does not require and discourages planning more than one sprint at a time. Most of us work in enterprises where we are dependent outside teams (for example: marketing, sales, support).

A rough assessment of the planned project scope is achievable within a reasonable time frame and resources. The goal is to have a rough plan and estimate as a starting point, not to implement "Agilefall."
Note that this is just a starting point to enable planning discussions. We expect the actual schedule to evolve and shift over time and that you will update the scope and timeline as you progress.
Delivery Plans ensure your teams are aligning with your organizational goals.
As you complete the assessment, you can push back on the scope, time frame or ask for more resources.
As you progress in your project/product delivery, you can highlight risks to the scope, time frame, and resources.
One approach you can take to accomplish is with stickies and a spreadsheet.
Stack rank the features for everything in your backlog - Functional Features - Non-functional Features - User Research and Design - Testing - Documentation - Knowledge Transfer/Support Processes
translations: Scrum 不要求、也不鼓励一次规划多个冲刺。但许多人在企业环境工作，项目需要依赖其他团队（例如市场、销售和支持团队）。
对计划的项目范围进行大致评估，判断其在合理的时间和资源范围内是否可行。目标是以一个大致的计划和估算作为起点，而不是实施"敏捷瀑布式"开发。
请注意，这仅是启动规划讨论的起点。我们预计实际进度会随时间演变和调整，并且您会在项目推进过程中更新范围和时间线。
交付计划确保您的团队与组织目标保持一致。
完成评估后，您可以对范围、时间线提出异议，或要求更多资源。
在项目/产品交付过程中，您可以突出范围、时间线和资源方面的风险。
您可以采用的一种方法是使用便利贴和电子表格。
按优先级排列待办清单中的工作项：功能需求、非功能需求、用户研究与设计、测试、文档、知识交接或支持流程。
fullTextParagraphs: While Scrum does not require and discourages planning more than one sprint at a time. Most of us work in enterprises where we are dependent outside teams (for example: marketing, sales, support).

A rough assessment of the planned project scope is achievable within a reasonable time frame and resources. The goal is to have a rough plan and estimate as a starting point, not to implement "Agilefall."
Note that this is just a starting point to enable planning discussions. We expect the actual schedule to evolve and shift over time and that you will update the scope and timeline as you progress.
Delivery Plans ensure your teams are aligning with your organizational goals.
As you complete the assessment, you can push back on the scope, time frame or ask for more resources.
As you progress in your project/product delivery, you can highlight risks to the scope, time frame, and resources.
One approach you can take to accomplish is with stickies and a spreadsheet.
Stack rank the features for everything in your backlog - Functional Features - Non-functional Features - User Research and Design - Testing - Documentation - Knowledge Transfer/Support Processes

T-Shirt Features in terms of working weeks per person. In some scenarios, you have no idea how complex the work. In this situation, you can ask for time to conduct a spike (timebox the effort so you can get back on time).

Calculate the capacity for the team based on the number of weeks person with his/her start and end date and minus holidays, vacation, conferences, training, and onboarding days. Also, minus time if the person is also working on defects and support.
Based on your capacity, you know have the options
Ask for more resources. Caution: onboarding new resources take time.

Reduce the scope to the most MVP. Caution: as you trim more of the scope, it might not be valuable anymore to the customer. Consider a cupcake which is everything you need. You don't want to skim off the frosting.
Ask for more time. Usually, this is the most flexible, but if there is a marketing date that you need to hit, this might be as flexible.
You can also leverage one of these tools by creating your epics and features and add the weeks estimates.

The Plans (Preview) feature on Azure DevOps will help you make a plan. Delivery Plans provide a schedule of stories or features your team plan to deliver. Delivery Plans show the scheduled work items by a sprint (iteration path) of selected teams against a calendar view.

Confluence JIRA, Trello, Rally, Asana, Basecamp, and GitHub Issues are other similar tools in the market (some are free, others you pay a monthly fee, or you can install on-prem) that you can leverage.

notes.example: Our success depends on effective communication with dependent outside teams.

notes.explain: 确保团队与组织目标保持一致的规划文档
notes.example: The Delivery Plans should be reviewed quarterly to align with changing business priorities.

notes.meaning: 对功能进行优先级排序

scenario.title: Explaining Milestones and Dependencies in Delivery Planning
english: Sarah, the project manager, needs to create a delivery plan for the new customer portal feature with her team.
The team has limited resources and must prioritize features while depending on outside teams for API integration.
Sarah explains the rough assessment of dependencies and stack ranks the features based on business impact and team capacity.
chinese: 项目经理Sarah需要为团队创建新的客户门户功能的交付计划。
团队资源有限，必须在依赖外部团队进行API集成的同时优先排序功能。
Sarah解释了依赖关系的初步评估，并根据业务影响和团队能力对功能进行优先级排序。

firstAttempt.prompt: 一个培训项目需要等待法务团队确认材料，确认时间还不清楚。请用英文提出先列出可确定的工作和暂定里程碑，等依赖明确后再更新计划。
firstAttempt.sample: Let’s map out the work we can confirm and mark the review as an open dependency. Once we know when Legal can finish, we can update the milestone dates.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先规划确定的工作并标记待确认依赖，等信息明确后调整里程碑。

words.example: The agile methodology discourages rigid planning that cannot adapt to change.
words.translation: 敏捷方法论不鼓励无法适应变化的僵化规划。
words.note: 常用于表示对某种做法的负面态度，暗示有更好的替代方案

words.example: We need to set realistic and achievable milestones for the project.
words.translation: 我们需要为项目设定切实可行的里程碑。
words.note: 强调目标在现有条件下的可行性，避免不切实际的期望

words.example: This is just a rough draft of the proposal; we'll refine it later.
words.translation: 这只是提案的初稿，我们稍后会进一步完善。
words.note: 表示不精确但足够作为初步指导的规划或估计

words.example: Our project strategy will evolve as we gather more user feedback.
words.translation: 随着我们收集更多用户反馈，项目策略将逐步演变。
words.note: 强调计划不是固定不变的，而是会根据新信息调整

words.example: The team is aligning their development priorities with the company's strategic goals.
words.translation: 团队正在将开发优先级与公司的战略目标保持一致。
words.note: 确保不同团队或部门的工作方向与整体目标协调

words.example: During the retrospective, we should highlight any potential risks for the next sprint.
words.translation: 在回顾会议上，我们应该强调下一轮冲刺中可能存在的风险。
words.note: 主动指出需要关注的问题，以便及时处理

structure.original: While Scrum does not require and discourages planning more than one sprint at a time.
analysis: While引导的让步状语从句，表示尽管如此
does not require and discourages是并列谓语结构，由and连接两个动词短语
planning more than one sprint at a time是动名词短语作宾语，其中more than one sprint和at a time都是介词短语作修饰成分
structure.transfer: Scrum focuses detailed planning on the next sprint so the team can adjust when new information arrives.

rewrite.bad: We need to promise a final delivery date now, even though we do not know when the API will be ready.
rewrite.good: Let’s map out the work we can confirm and mark the review as an open dependency. Once we know when Legal can finish, we can update the milestone dates.
rewrite.translation: 我们先列出目前可以确定的工作，并把评审标记为尚未解决的依赖。等法务确认完成时间后，再更新里程碑日期。
rewrite.pattern: Let’s map out [the work we can confirm] and mark [the review] as an open dependency. Once we know [the timing], we can update [the milestone dates].

cloze.prompt: Let’s map ___ the work we can confirm.
cloze.why: map out 表示把工作内容或计划梳理清楚。

cloze.prompt: Mark the review as an open ___.
cloze.why: open dependency 表示当前计划依赖一项尚未确定的信息。

cloze.prompt: Once we know when Legal can finish, we can update the milestone ___.
cloze.why: 等依赖日期明确后再更新里程碑安排。

choice.prompt: 客户门户项目依赖外部 API 团队，交付时间还不确定。请用英文说明可以先做一个初步计划，并在依赖时间明确后调整里程碑。
options: We need to make the delivery plan now. The external team will tell us when they're done.
Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know, then update the milestones once the API team’s timing is clearer.
Let’s make a rough plan based on what we know.
choice.why: 先用估算作为起点，依赖信息变化时再调整计划。

output.prompt: 供应商的接口预计下月交付，但日期尚未确认。请用英文建议先规划不受该接口影响的工作，把交付列为开放依赖，并在日期确认后调整里程碑。
output.sample: Let’s map out the work we can confirm and mark the vendor handoff as an open dependency. Once we know the delivery date, we can update the milestone dates.
check: 是否先安排目前可以确认的工作？
是否标出尚未确定的依赖？
是否把调整里程碑放到依赖时间明确之后？
